dimension_reasoning.substantive_criticism: The response delivers multiple specific critical claims: 1) The non-interference principle (Article 2(e) of the ASEAN Charter) causes procedural paralysis and shields atrocities, as seen with Myanmar's 2021 coup and the ignored Five-Point Consensus. 2) The ASEAN Intergovernmental Commission on Human Rights (AICHR) is designed to neutralize criticism through prohibitions on investigations and complaint mechanisms, with commissioners serving state interests. 3) The ASEAN Economic Community (AEC) excludes low-skilled labor categories, creating precarity and lack of protections, while binding labor standards are absent. 4) The ASEAN Agreement on Transboundary Haze Pollution lacks enforcement, leading to persistent environmental harm from Indonesia's peatland fires.
